user.title: EnBW Charging Station
user.description: Choose how to add a charging station.

manual.title: Enter Station Details
manual.description: Enter the station ID. You can find it with a location search, or in your browser's developer tools on the [EnBW charging map](https://www.enbw.com/elektromobilitaet/produkte/mobilityplus-app/ladestation-finden/map).

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave empty to use the public key of the EnBW charging map; it is refreshed automatically if EnBW changes it.

search.title: Search for Stations
search.description: Search for charging stations near a location.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave empty to use the public key of the EnBW charging map; it is refreshed automatically if EnBW changes it.

select_station.title: Select Station
select_station.description: Select a charging station from the search results.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Station

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave empty to use the public key of the EnBW charging map; it is refreshed automatically if EnBW changes it.

reconfigure.description: Change the followed station, e.g. after the operator re-registered it under a new ID.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave empty to use the public key of the EnBW charging map; it is refreshed automatically if EnBW changes it.

reauth_confirm.title: Update API key
reauth_confirm.description: The EnBW API rejected the API key.

error.no_stations_found: No stations found in this area

station_not_found.title: Charging station {title} not found
station_not_found.description: EnBW no longer knows station ID {station_id}, and no station at the same address was found nearby. Operators sometimes re-register stations under a new ID. Find the new ID with a location search and open **Settings → Devices & services → EnBW Charging Stations → {title} → ⋮ → Reconfigure** to switch to it, or remove the entry if the station is gone.
